title: MFTCXplain: A Multilingual Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating the Moral Reasoning of LLMs through Multi-hop Hate Speech Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the alignment of LLM-generated moral classifications and multi-hop rationales with expert human annotations based on Moral Foundations Theory across four culturally diverse settings to identify misalignments with culturally contingent moral frameworks.

Comparing LLM performance metrics (F1 score, Jaccard similarity, BERTScore) in hate speech classification and moral sentiment prediction across English, Italian, Portuguese, and Persian to measure performance disparities between high-resource and underrepresented languages.
